name: xlsx_write
description: Create an Excel .xlsx workbook from rows of values, one or more sheets. Strings starting with '=' become formulas. No styles, charts or dates.

path.description: .xlsx file to write, relative to the working folder

sheets.description: {sheet name: [[value, ...], ...]}: rows from cell A1; a value is a string, number, boolean or null (empty); a string starting with '=' is a formula

overwrite.description: replace the file when it exists (default false)

edge_cases: sheet name too long or with forbidden characters
